original_test_intent: Verify that each applicable Type 17 Maximum Voltage field reports the approved highest supported module voltage in millivolts, or zero as Unknown under policy, is not below known minimum/configured values, and remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 data with SMBIOS version/length; gate the field by schema, bind its raw 16-bit value to locator/module identity, decode zero versus millivolts, compare trusted module voltage envelope and min/configured/max ordering, and repeat after reboot without applying voltage.
manual_activity: A user approves module voltage-envelope policy and reboot plan. The core check is read-only metadata validation, not an over-voltage stimulus.
required_inputs: Expected maximum supported voltage per populated locator/device class
Applicable SMBIOS version and minimum Type 17 length
Policy for raw zero Unknown and empty records
Expected minimum/configured relationship and trusted module specification
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/inventory; never apply the reported maximum or change BIOS voltage settings.
Gate the field by formatted length and preserve the raw 16-bit value.
Interpret zero as Unknown, not 0 V.
When known, require minimum <= configured <= maximum under the approved definitions.
Do not treat declared maximum as live sensor telemetry; stop on ambiguity or reboot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate field presence, raw zero/mV semantics, per-device baseline and full envelope ordering, then compare pre/post reboot evidence.
Do not alter voltage, perform electrical stress or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-device maximum/envelope and Unknown/applicability policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, assess specification conflicts and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot prove structure length, locator, raw zero semantics or minimum/configured relationship.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 17 data; report locator/module identity, structure length, raw maximum, Unknown/normalized mV and min/configured/max ordering.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Maximum voltage scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and any voltage/firmware changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate Maximum Voltage by Type 17 length, decode raw zero/millivolts, compare trusted module limit and min/configured/max ordering, and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 implementations containing module voltage fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and module-spec/SPD decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 voltage-field definitions and authoritative module/platform voltage specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds length, raw zero, locator identity and full envelope constraints.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects absent/truncated fields, Unknown misread as 0 V, maximum below configured/minimum and wrong-slot limits.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-device supported voltage envelope and applicability policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The declaration is not permission to drive the rail to this value and does not prove live voltage regulation.

project_override_considerations: A project may allow Unknown where firmware omits voltage metadata, but must scope the exception; board nominal voltage and module supported maximum are different quantities and cannot silently substitute for each other.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module identity, per-locator maximum/envelope and zero/applicability policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17 records with SMBIOS version/length
Per-device raw maximum, Unknown/normalized mV and envelope-order result
Trusted module/board specification comparison distinct from sensor data
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic voltage diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Maximum voltage is a defined companion to minimum/configured voltage; expected values are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Schema, numeric and envelope checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-voltage-change safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates declared supported maximum from applied/live voltage and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible decoded maximum from passing when absent, Unknown, tied to the wrong device or below configured/minimum voltage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Field presence, raw millivolts and ordering constraints are deterministic software checks and require no electrical stimulus.
